simple.summary: וַיְזָתָא (Vayzâthâʼ) means Vajezatha , a son of Haman First listed occurrence: Esth 9 9.

definitions.full: H2055. Vayzatha וַיְזָתָא proper name, masculine (perhaps = Persian proper name, masculine Vahyazdâta Benfey Pers. Keilinschr. (1847) 18, 93 compare Spieg APK 240 , who conjectures meaning given-of-the-Best-One (vom Besten gegeben)), — a son of Haman Est 9:9 . וֶלֶד וָלָד, see below ילד .
